graph.num_nodes: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
graph.num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
graph.nodes: <list[int], length num_nodes> Vertices of the graph, each identified by a unique integer label.
graph.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pairs of vertices connected by an edge, where each pair contains two distinct vertex labels.
